//ToothPullerBlueprint: The recipe for CardData/Item/hw_tooth_puller.json, metal tongs (owner, 2026-10-15: 'the tooth puller needs to be a metal tongs object that you craft'), VANILLA CARDS ONLY so the last-resort tooth decay cure never needs another mod (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/afflictions.md section 3.5 point 3, the second tooth decay DECISION; shape copied from CardData/Blueprint/hw_bp_herbal_wash.json, read its note). A construction-style blueprint registered through HarshWilds/BlueprintTabs.json under the vanilla Survival > Medical tab ('Tab_1_Survival_Subtab_3_Medical_TabName'). Researchable from the start: StartUnlocked false with empty CardsOnBoard, TagsOnBoard and StatValues, basic research time BlueprintUnlockTicksCost HW_TOOTH_PULLER_RESEARCH = 4, one stage of BuildingDaytimeCost 2 (HW_TOOTH_PULLER_BUILD, the cap is 12). Ingredient, vanilla and spent: one metal bar (MetalBarFinished, 14f7ddfe60496b54881d5a25de8abb20, the card vanilla's smithed blanks and ACT's Cautery Iron consume; its in-game name reads Heated Metal Bar), any metal type, with no AffectResultDurabilities mask because the tongs carry no metal or quality stat. No hammer is required: a vanilla tool requirement is a tab-group reference whose export names are obfuscated, so it cannot be authored here. Until 0.11.7 the recipe was Bones (674b640f46671f1418af4559b259b442) and Twine (f6e8281ffa0e6eb4b8bf1dc5e5ae1338) for a bone hook. The quantities are TUNABLE PLACEHOLDERS, session-inferred and unmeasured against play.

CardDescription.DefaultText: Work a metal bar into a pair of narrow tongs for pulling a rotten tooth. The jaws wear loose after a few pulls.
